finding: Antares stores 138 public service records and 24 organisation entities. End-to-end verification creates a review event, updates the target state and reads it back.

limitations: Public registry snapshot, not current operating status. Some units match library-related services rather than a standalone library. Source fields may be incomplete. Review decisions are local prototype annotations, not municipality or business-owner approval. Antares runs in memory. Review projections reset on restart. No full ETSI conformance certification or production authentication is claimed.
